resources.string: Shortcuts beside search on every settings page
Undo, redo, history and more, one press away on every page
global icons, quick buttons, toolbar, shortcuts, undo, redo, history, restore point, home, recent pages

Each button you turn on sits in the bar at the top of every settings page, left of search, in the order of this list. Undo and redo go to the setting they changed and flash it, opening its page if you are on another one. Touch and hold Undo for the last 10 minutes, your restore points and the change history. Undo and redo need the change history, under Backup and restore, Undo and restore points. Only Search is on at first, which is the bar the app always had.
